items.label: Sturdy & Stylish PE Rattan
items.value: Crafted with hand-woven PE rattan, this half-moon patio furniture set blends durability with aesthetics. The mix brown rattan is breathable, sun-proof and fade-resistant, withstanding the test of time in your outdoor space. Note: Please avoid rain exposure for prolonged service life.

items.label: Comfort Meets Convenience
items.value: Filled with high-elastic sponge, the soft back and seat cushions of this patio conversation set will provide an extra layer of comfort. Moreover, the smooth zippers on each cushion cover allow for simple removal and cleaning, making your seats clean and inviting.

items.label: Heavy Duty Construction
items.value: Constructed with robust metal frames, the patio curved sofa set boasts outstanding durability and sturdiness. Additionally, the strong connectors and adjustable foot pads enhance the stability, ensuring you a reliable seating option.

items.label: Variety in Configurations
items.value: This outdoor sectional furniture set includes 2 loveseat sofas and 3 side tables that can be used together or separately. You can arrange them according to your needs, creating a great addition to your patio, backyard, or poolside area.
